announcements.text: vpn/services/gatus/config/config.yaml carries live credentials in plaintext, including SSH private-key blocks. Never grep it with a context flag (-A/-B), and never print a parsed form of it - json.dumps of a single endpoint dict renders the key field verbatim. Read the KEY NAMES only; to compare a value, hash it in place. The read discipline is necessary but not sufficient: the PRINT is the second chokepoint, and it is the one that fails when the read felt safe. A third chokepoint is any TOOL whose output path renders the file's content: a diff, a checksum-and-dump, or a guard that prints a drift diff between two key-bearing copies discloses both. Read the output path before you ship the tool, not after.

announcements.text: session_notify's 'now' mode is RETIRED and passing it FAILS the delivery outright - it is not merely discouraged. 'turn-end' is the default and wakes an idle target immediately, so it loses nothing 'now' ever delivered; 'quiet' is retained for batch notices whose ack contract is the ledger. 'interrupt' is the URGENT tier (#393): it delivers at the SAME boundary as turn-end and adds precedence framing so the target yields its current plan and answers in that turn - never deferred, never a default, spell it explicitly. It is NOT pre-emption: no boundary exists inside a running tool call, so a mid-turn target still queues for its next tool-loop boundary. Legacy interrupt:true UPGRADES a non-quiet resolution to that tier. A 'no wake observed' confirm verdict does NOT mean the target is mid-turn — a mid-turn target returns `queued_pending_drain`. The unconfirmed verdict means the probe read the target idle and no wake was seen inside the 10s cap, so it cannot distinguish 'queued, will drain' from 'folded into a turn-settle window and never re-armed' (opencrabs/opencrabs#2003: in the settle window the probe reads idle while the turn is still finishing, the notice joins the settling turn, and no wake is re-armed — measured 5m41s undrained). Never re-send on the verdict alone: re-check the target's own store first.

announcements.text: session_notify's 'now' mode is RETIRED and passing it FAILS the delivery outright - it is not merely discouraged. 'turn-end' is the default and wakes an idle target immediately, so it loses nothing 'now' ever delivered; 'quiet' is retained for batch notices whose ack contract is the ledger. 'interrupt' is the URGENT tier (#393): it delivers at the SAME boundary as turn-end and adds precedence framing so the target yields its current plan and answers in that turn - never deferred, never a default, spell it explicitly. It is NOT pre-emption: no boundary exists inside a running tool call, so a mid-turn target still queues for its next tool-loop boundary. Legacy interrupt:true UPGRADES a non-quiet resolution to that tier. A 'no wake observed' confirm verdict does NOT mean the target is mid-turn — a mid-turn target returns `queued_pending_drain`. The unconfirmed verdict means the probe read the target idle and no wake was seen inside the 10s cap, so it cannot distinguish 'queued, will drain' from 'folded into a turn-settle window and never re-armed' (opencrabs/opencrabs#2003: in the settle window the probe reads idle while the turn is still finishing, the notice joins the settling turn, and no wake is re-armed — measured 5m41s undrained). Never re-send on the verdict alone: re-check the target's own store first.

jobs.name: ai-antispam-triage-sweep
jobs.trigger_cmd: out=$(timeout 25 /usr/bin/python3 -u /root/.opencrabs/profiles/ops/skills/ai-antispam/tools/triage_state_gate.py 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "TRIAGE GATE FAILED (fail-open): gate exited rc=$rc"; fi; printf '%s' "$out"

jobs.name: infra-handler-escalation-check
jobs.trigger_cmd: P=$(XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/0 systemctl --user show opencrabs.service -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$P" ] && { echo "default daemon: no MainPID (unit down)"; exit 0; }; [ ! -r /proc/$P/stat ] && { echo "default daemon pid $P not readable"; exit 0; }; A=$(awk '{print $14+$15}' /proc/$P/stat); sleep 5; B=$(awk '{print $14+$15}' /proc/$P/stat); D=$((B-A)); C=$(awk -v d=$D 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", d/500}'); [ $D -gt 100 ] && echo "default daemon BURNING: $D jiffies/5s (${C} core)"; W=$(ls -la /proc/$P/fd/ 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'opencrabs.db-wal (deleted)'); [ "$W" -gt 0 ] && echo "default daemon still on UNLINKED WAL inode"; true

jobs.name: factory-triage-patrol
jobs.trigger_cmd: out=$(gh issue list -R leshchenko1979/agent-factories --state open --limit 5 --json number --jq "length" 2>/dev/null) || { echo "triage-trigger: gh FAILED - failing OPEN"; exit 0; }; if [ "$out" = "0" ]; then echo "triage-trigger: 0 open issues - silent"; exit 1; fi; echo "triage-trigger: $out open issues - firing"; exit 0

jobs.name: oc-629-fallback-watch
jobs.trigger_cmd: p=$(printf "%s.*%s%s" "rich::api" "falling back to " "html dialect"); find /root/.opencrabs/profiles/ops/logs -maxdepth 1 -name "opencrabs.2026-*" -mtime -3 -exec grep -hE "$p" {} + 2>/dev/null | awk -v s="2026-09-27T11:19:38" "substr(\$0,1,19) > s" 2>/dev/null

jobs.name: oc-harvest-402-resume
jobs.trigger_cmd: L=/root/.opencrabs/profiles/ops/skills/opencrabs-dev/tools/oc-ledger; out=$(timeout -s KILL 25 "$L" events --n 20000 --kind note 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "402 mode-gate unreadable rc=$rc - failing OPEN -- $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -c 300)"; exit 0; fi; m=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -F'\t' '$5 ~ /^MODE: / {m=$5} END {print m}'); if [ -z "$m" ]; then echo "402 mode-gate: no MODE note in the ledger - failing OPEN"; exit 0; fi; case "$m" in "MODE: DEGRADED"*) exit 0 ;; *) echo "402 mode register changed to [$m] - re-measure and act." ;; esac

jobs.name: oc-harvest-403-resume
jobs.trigger_cmd: D=/root/.opencrabs/profiles/ops/skills/opencrabs-dev/tools; L="$D/state/oc-ledger"; [ -x "$L" ] || L="$D/oc-ledger"; if [ ! -x "$L" ]; then echo "403 mode-gate: oc-ledger not found under $D - failing OPEN"; exit 0; fi; out=$(timeout -s KILL 25 "$L" events --n 20000 --kind note 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "403 mode-gate unreadable rc=$rc - failing OPEN -- $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -c 300)"; exit 0; fi; m=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -F'\t' '$5 ~ /^MODE: / {m=$5} END {print m}'); if [ -z "$m" ]; then echo "403 mode-gate: no MODE note in the ledger - failing OPEN"; exit 0; fi; case "$m" in "MODE: DEGRADED"*) exit 0 ;; *) echo "403 mode register changed to [$m] - re-measure and act." ;; esac

jobs.name: oc-roster-detached-sweep
jobs.trigger_cmd: ROSTER=/root/.opencrabs/profiles/ops/skills/opencrabs-dev/tools/oc-roster; out=$("$ROSTER" classify 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "roster-classify FAILED rc=$rc - failing OPEN"; echo "$out"; exit 0; fi; printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep "^ORPHAN" || exit 1

jobs.name: opencrabs-dev-fork766-verify
